goal: Make the production apply review refuse a missing or non-numeric source_pr by name, before any production credential is used, whenever the automatic risk policy is active, without relaxing, removing or reordering any existing guard.
prohibited_actions: No shared database reads or writes, no production or preview apply or workflow dispatch, no migration files, no removal or weakening of any existing guard or check, no fabricated reviews.
assumptions: source_pr is required whenever the automatic policy is active; preview inputs may become conditional (open PR #2771), so only source_pr is checked early.
stop_conditions: The fix would need to remove, weaken or reorder an existing guard.
